purpose_context: After the Markua-subset feature merged (PR #33), three follow-ups were filed: a flaky a11y deck-diagram theme-toggle test (#34), a hand-maintained re-derive parse mirror that drifts from the build remark stack by convention (#35), and an asymmetric Markua deck-scope guard where only one of five passes is deck-aware (#36). This mission closes each as a defect class with a regression test, keeps base behaviour and the merged Markua feature intact, and records the deck-scope decision (decks are Markua-agnostic for now).
purpose_tldr: Resolve three follow-up issues from the Markua merge so the a11y lane stops flaking and the Markua/re-derive boundaries are structurally guarded.
